concentration_time_figure.note: Blood Cy7 fluorescence (converted to concentration via standard curve) versus time after single intravenous dose; sampling at 2, 5, 15, 30 min, 1, 2, 4, 8, 12 and 24 h.

bioanalytical_method: Fluorescence spectrophotometry of the Cy7 label in blood/organ lysate (PerkinElmer), quantified against a standard curve; PK parameters computed with DAS 2.1.1 software
bioanalytical_quote: the fluorescence signal of Cy7 was detected through the fluorescence spectrophotometer (PerkinElmer, USA) and calculated according to the standard curve
bioanalytical_section: METHODS - Pharmacokinetic and biodistribution study of Cy7-labeled DC vesicles
notes: PK (t1/2, AUC) was reported only for the Cy7-labeled agents (IL-15-Cy7 and biNV-IL-15-Cy7); no dose amount for the PK arm is given in the body. Body reports a 6.6-fold higher AUC for biNV-IL-15-Cy7 versus free IL-15-Cy7 but no absolute AUC value. No amino acid sequence, SMILES or CAS is printed anywhere in the body for IL-15 or the vesicle components. D-luciferin (3 mg per mouse, i.p.) and isoflurane/anesthetics were administered but are imaging substrate/anesthesia rather than test agents and were not listed as agents. Several body paragraphs in the source file were truncated at 2000 characters, so some mid-paragraph detail may be missing.
